decision.notDeletable: This decision comes from the game or a mod’s original file: the game would still show it from that file if the project’s row were deleted, so it cannot be deleted here.
decision.addNote: The new decision is for {tag} only, costs 0 and has no conditions or effects; once created it opens here for you to keep editing.

override.heading: Copy into my mod to edit
override.vanillaNote: Saving copies all of {file} into your mod (you are asked the first time); everything else in the file stays as it is. The change applies to every country that uses this decision.
override.modNote: This changes {file} in your mod, and only this decision.
override.note: Scripts such as conditions and effects cannot be changed here yet; a mistake can be undone in the “Change log”.
override.confirmTitle: Copy the base-game file into your mod
override.confirmBody:
All of the base-game file {file} will be copied into your mod, replacing the game’s file of the same name; the other decisions and other countries’ content in it stay as they are.
This change applies to every country that uses this decision; if a game update changes this file, your copy will not follow automatically.
override.fileFallback: the file that declares this decision
override.importedDone: Copied {file} into your mod and made the change.

problem.cost: Cost must be a number of 0 or more
problem.icon: Write the icon as its name in the files (letters, digits, underscores)
problem.days: Days must be a whole number of 0 or more

focus.notInTree: The project’s copy of this tree does not have this focus.
focus.prereqHint: One group per line: any one focus of a group will do; every group must be met.

link.self: A focus cannot link to itself.
link.loop: That would make a loop: that focus itself needs this one done first.

focusTree.created: Created focus tree {id}; right-click an empty spot to place its first focus
focusTree.label: {tag} focus tree
focusTree.newIdPlaceholder: New tree id (leave blank to name it automatically)
focusTree.createNote: The new tree goes into the project, for {tag}; the game picks a tree by weight, so an empty tree will not replace the existing one.

event.unreadable: This event is not in the project data, and how it looks in the game could not be read.

problem.timeoutDays: Timeout days must be a whole number of 0 or more
problem.mtth: An event that is not triggered only by scripts needs a mean time to happen (e.g. days = 30)

eventSwitcher.notInProject: The event on screen is not in the project data, so there is no namespace to put a new event in.
eventSwitcher.totalPartial: Events: {total} · showing the first {shown}, search for the rest
eventSwitcher.totalAll: Events: {total} · drag the scrollbar on the right to skim through
eventSwitcher.genericEvents: Generic events (any country may get these)
eventSwitcher.noCountryEvents: This country has no events; switch to “All events” to look.
eventSwitcher.newEventNote: It goes into the namespace of the event on screen, numbered after the last one; fired only by scripts, it never pops up on its own.
eventSwitcher.noSuperEvents: The project has no super events yet.

bookmark.notInProject: This bookmark is not in the project data (it comes from the base game or a mod file); import it into the project to edit it here.
